newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama police score biggest drug bust this year.
newsitem.headline: Panama police score biggest drug bust this year.

text.p: Panama's anti-drug police seized nearly 2,800 pounds (1,240 kg) of cocaine and arrested four Colombians and one Guatemalan in the largest drug bust this year, a police spokesman said Tuesday.
Police found the drugs late Monday hidden inside a house in Panama City and in a container left outside.

The spokesman said the men, who exchanged gunfire with police before being captured, probably belonged to an international drug ring which uses Panama as a transit point to take drugs from neighboring Colombia to the United States.
